# LXRCore RedM Framework

> LXRCore v3 is an independent, proprietary RedM (RDR3 / Cfx.re) roleplay framework by iBoss21 / LXRCore. It is not a fork of any other framework: it has its own API (`GetLXR()`), event vocabulary (`lxr:<domain>:<verb>`), data catalog, migrations, money ledger, offline test suite and an 1899-accurate economy.

- License: LXRCore Framework License v1.0 (all rights reserved; public-API grant for third-party resources). Not GPL, not MIT.
- Website: https://www.lxrcore.com
- Organisation: https://github.com/LXRCore
- Documentation: https://github.com/LXRCore/Docs
- Custom GPT: https://chatgpt.com/g/g-BHWBnVcFd-lxrcore-redm-framework
- Reference server: The Land of Wolves — https://discord.gg/wolvesland

- [Events](docs/events.md): `lxr:player:*`, `lxr:money:*`, `lxr:job:*`, `lxr:inventory:*`, RPC wire
- [Exports](docs/exports.md)
- [Shared data catalog](docs/data.md): 579 items, 61 weapons, 145 horse coats, 60 wagons, 55 jobs, 18 gangs, 1899 price ledger
